page.layout: One column of running text, with one marginal note in the right margin beside "Et". Running head at top centre-left, page number top right. Catchword "ponte" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: ter declivè utrimque, à Drentiæ campis sublimibus ac spatiosis venièns, velut lingua exilis, sed longa, & senfim se versus finem coarctans, omnem ferè Præfe-cturam suburbanam percurrens. In ejus dorsi parte penè ultimâ, quâ amnium alter Aha ipsum dorsum propiùs accedens quasi stringit, posita Groninga est, arctior olim & in ipsissimo solùm dorso ædificata, deinde ampliata paulatim, & devexa ac humiliora utrinque largiùs complexa, loco perquàm felice, curribusque & navigiis ad importandum pariter commodo, segetibus & pascuis in ambitu inprimis fortunato. Dorsum autem illud modicè ad bina circiter stadia ultra urbem boream versùs procurrit, ibiqúe molliter se deponens in humilem & æquam planiciem definit, mediâ ferè inter urbem & cœnobium Selwerdicum viâ. EtAha f.[?] amnis quidem Aha, ut nunc dudum res habuit, & habet, in angulo urbis, qui inter meridiem & occidentem prominet, mœnibus se insinuat per amplos fornices sub vallo structos, intraq; mœnia occiduo in latere urbem stringens longo tractu, & ponte

page.notes: The marginal note beside "Et" is set in a small italic/bold face and reads as "Aha" with a mark, possibly "f."; the exact mark is doubtful. The running head and page number are read from the top of the scan. Show-through and the digitiser's watermark at the bottom right are omitted.
